28cd2263eeedb7ef2fd2eed3: This field records the date and time of the patient's admission to inpatient care or when they were roomed in the ED. It checks if item EPT 10290 is populated; if so, it captures the moment the patient was first admitted (using EPT 10290 and 10291). If not, it assesses the version of the standard unique patient denominator in use (LSD 34062) and whether the patient was an ED patient (EPT 10296 and 10297). If the denominator is for all ED patients, this field will contain the hospital admission date and time (EPT 18850 and 18851). If the patient was neither inpatient nor seen in the ED, this field will be null. If the denominator is for ED to Observation patients only and the patient was seen in the ED as an observation patient, this field will be populated with the hospital admission date and time (EPT 18850 and 18851).
